title: Senjou No Fuuga: Kotetsu No Melody
titleRomaji: Senjou No Fuuga: Kotetsu No Melody
titleNative: 戦場のフーガ 鋼鉄のメロディ
synopsis: This is the official comic adaptation of the SRPG "Fuga: Melodies of Steel," based on the theme of "war, revenge, and beasts." In order to find their families who were captured in the war, the boys and girls board the mysterious giant tank "Taranis" and begin their journey of revenge....... (Source: Famitsu, translated)

title: Osananajimi no Watashi wa Mob de Itai Noni, Naze ka Heroine no Renai Taishou ni Natteiru.
titleRomaji: Osananajimi no Watashi wa Mob de Itai Noni, Naze ka Heroine no Renai Taishou ni Natteiru.
titleNative: 幼馴染のわたしはモブでいたいのに、なぜかヒロインの恋愛対象になっている。
synopsis: When Mashiro Yukizuki is reincarnated into the world of a gal-game as “Ryona Amezuki,” one of the heroines of the game, she decides she wants to live as inconspicuously as possible. But when she helps to rescue “Ririnri Hinahoshi” from being harassed by a man downtown, she finds herself in the middle of a love affair. Now everything she tries backfires, as Ryona finds herself attracting the love interest of more and more heroines… (Source: Digicata, translated)
